title: Can You Change the Date of a Boat Trip in Madeira After Booking?
description: Yes, if you act over 24 hours before departure: a direct Chifbay booking cancels free until then, so you can rebook. If the sea is unsafe, you get a new date.
heroAlt: A coffee and a phone on a hotel balcony table above a ruffled sea in Funchal
keywords: can you change the date of a boat trip in Madeira
change booking date boat tour Funchal
boat trip cancelled weather Madeira new date
move a private boat trip to another day
